title: SFSMP Modpack
description: This is the modpack that will be used in Snow Flake SMP (SFSMP), it will revamp your vanilla minecraft experience, with Muskets, Cooking system, cars, decorations, revamped dimensions and others.
body:
The modpack that will be used in a future minecraft SMP named SFSMP

RECOMENDATIONS:
it is recommended that you use shaders of your choice, fresh player animations and fresh mobs, as well as 3D Muskets for a better experience.
